summary: Verified the 'UPLOAD EXCEL DATA GAGAL' fix (missing openpyxl) end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/hrd/import-template (valid .xlsx, PIN-gated) and POST /api/hrd/payslips/import-excel (valid MKS slip -> 200 + persistence in GET /api/hrd/payslips, re-import upserts without duplicates, non-slip xlsx -> clean 400 Indonesian message, corrupt bytes -> 400, missing x-hrd-gaji -> 403). Frontend: full UI flow as herliana (login -> Data Gaji -> PIN 1234 -> Slip Gaji tab) works; 'Template' button downloads a valid xlsx (PK magic, 5218 bytes), 'Upload Excel' returns HTTP 200 with success toast 'Import selesai: ... karyawan' and the imported row (TEST_UI Rahmat, Take Home Rp 4.410.000) appears in the table; wrong-format file shows toast "Tidak ditemukan sheet slip gaji ('SLIP GAJI')..." with HTTP 400 (no 500). No 500s observed in this session; openpyxl tracebacks in backend.err.log are all pre-fix (before the last restart at line 229).

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription to Radix dialogs

action_items: No functional action required for the reported bug — openpyxl==3.1.5 is present in /app/backend/requirements.txt (line 70), so the fix will survive redeploy.

Optional (low): the 'Upload Excel' button exposes data-testid only on the hidden file input (hrd-import-input); the visible Button/span has no 'hrd-import' testid as referenced in the request — add data-testid="hrd-import" to the visible button for stable UI automation.
Optional (low): add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent to clear a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: hrd.py import_excel(): imports openpyxl lazily inside the handler, so a missing dependency surfaces only as a runtime 500 at upload time. Consider importing at module load (fails fast at startup) or wrapping in try/except ImportError with a 503 + clear message.
hrd.py is 1467 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting payroll/payslip logic (parsing, import/export, email blast) into separate modules.
Old log shows 'KeyError: JWT_SECRET' from a previous run — confirm JWT_SECRET is always required/validated at startup rather than raising a KeyError mid-request.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: 'openpyxl' was not installed in the migrated environment; hrd.py imports it lazily inside import_excel() and import_template(), so both endpoints raised ModuleNotFoundError -> HTTP 500 ('UPLOAD EXCEL DATA GAGAL'). Fix (openpyxl==3.1.5 installed, present in requirements.txt) verified: both endpoints now return 200 with valid xlsx / import results, and malformed input yields a proper 400.
